reason: The README clearly describes a DSH voice interaction plugin that captures browser microphone input, uses a host WebSocket route, integrates Volcengine streaming speech recognition and synthesis, and presents voice controls in the composer and settings.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供实时语音交互，通过浏览器麦克风输入、Volcengine 语音识别与语音合成实现语音对话。
summaries.en: Provides real-time voice interaction for DSH using browser microphone input together with Volcengine streaming speech recognition and speech synthesis.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio in the browser
Streams audio and control messages over a host WebSocket route
Sends microphone audio to Volcengine streaming ASR
Sends assistant reply text to Volcengine streaming TTS
Plays synthesized audio in the browser
Reads VOLCENGINE_API_KEY from the host environment
Can cancel an in-flight DSH agent turn
